subject: The Heart's True Exercise Threshold: Why 150 Minutes May Be Just the Beginning
script: From Agewell Brief: The Heart's True Exercise Threshold: Why 150 Minutes May Be Just the Beginning. New research suggests that substantial cardiovascular protection may require nearly 10 hours of weekly activity—far beyond current guidelines. Here's what the dose-response curve really means for your heart. Read the full source-linked dispatch and primary study caveats at AgewellBrief.com.
